name: XCC_TR_HEADERS_HISTORY
description: This table contains budgetary control transactions that have been purged from the regular XCC_TR_HEADERS table. You must save the contents of this table for audit purposes. You can also archive them to some other storage location.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the type of transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_1
columns.description: Primary key for the subledger or general ledger transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_2
columns.description: Primary key for the subledger or general ledger transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number for the subledger or general ledger.

columns.name: SOURCE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Commitment control action for subledger or general ledger. Valid values depend on the subledger and transaction type involved.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the budgetary control transaction or group of transactions processed in a run.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Status of the budgetary control transaction.

columns.name: ARRIVAL_ORDER
columns.description: If multiple transactions are being processed at once, order in which they should be considered.

columns.name: DRAFT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this funds activity was attempted in draft mode or final mode. Funds activities attempted in draft mode do not reserve funds. They just check whether the funds activity would have passed. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is a budget transaction. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this transaction used an override. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger associated with this transaction. It is NULL for Oracle Fusion General Ledger and Oracle Fusion Subledger Accounting data, as the ledger is a line level attribute for those products. It is also NULL for budget adjustment data.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business unit of this transaction. It is NULL for Oracle Fusion General Ledger data, Oracle Fusion Subledger Accounting data, and budget adjustment data. It is also NULL when the transaction type or action supports line level business units.

columns.name: DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Destination type.  Valid values are EXPENSE or INVENTORY.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction source. Populated for Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management data only.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Document type. Populated for Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management data only.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Journal source for general ledger. Populated for Oracle Fusion General Ledger and Oracle Fusion Subledger Accounting data only.

columns.name: LIQUIDATION_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Method by which the liquidation date must be obtained.

columns.name: PARTIAL_RESERVATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if partial reservations are allowed. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: OVERRIDABLE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of override available when running in override or override check mode.

columns.name: DATA_PURGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether one or more lines have been purged for this transaction.

columns.name: HEADER_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Code that groups multiple transactions for budgetary control. Transactions with this value will pass or fail budgetary control as a group.

columns.name: FAILURE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code when budgetary control fails due to reason other than failed budgetary control activity. Possible reasons include failure of related transactions, failure of related lines, or burdening failure.

columns.name: SUCCESS_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code when budgetary control activity is not generated. Possible reasons include budgetary control is not applicable, or control budgets are not applicable to the transaction line. The transaction line may still fail budgetary control if a related transaction or a related transaction line fails.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
